info.name: Crunchbase Data API v4 Autocomplete Entity Lookup API

params.name: collection
params.description: The core entity collection (e.g. organizations, people, funding_rounds, acquisitions).

params.name: entity_id
params.description: The entity UUID or permalink (e.g. tesla-motors).

params.name: field_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of field ids to return for the entity.

params.name: card_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of related card ids to include. Each card returns a maximum of 100 items; use the card endpoint for more.

items.docs: Retrieves a single entity from a core collection (organizations, people, funding_rounds, acquisitions, and others) by its UUID or permalink. Use field_ids to select fields and card_ids to include related cards (each card returns at most 100 items).

params.name: collection
params.description: The core entity collection (e.g. organizations, people, funding_rounds, acquisitions).

params.name: entity_id
params.description: The entity UUID or permalink (e.g. tesla-motors).

params.name: card_id
params.description: The id of the related card to page through (e.g. raised_funding_rounds, investors).

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of items to return per page.

params.name: after_id
params.description: Keyset cursor - return items after this entity id.

params.name: before_id
params.description: Keyset cursor - return items before this entity id.

items.docs: Retrieves a single related card for an entity with full pagination, used when a card holds more than the 100 items returned inline by the entity lookup endpoint.
